sourcing: Every price, SKU, option list and image below was pulled from the brand's own public Shopify feed on 2026-09-26. Products the user listed that could not be verified (blocked sites, or names that do not exist as listed) were replaced with a same-type product from a brand feed that answers, and each replacement is named in the notes.

products.name: Ruffwear Crag Reflective Dog Collar
products.description: Ruffwear's everyday reflective dog collar, stocked from 9 to 26 in across a large spread of seasonal colourways. The reflective webbing helps a dog be spotted on dusk and night walks.
products.image_alt: Ruffwear Crag reflective dog collar in granite gray
products.notes: Chosen variant '11"-14" / Granite Gray (035) / New', USD 24.49, store SKU 25802-0351114. Store options: 11"-14"; Tropical Bloom (946); New; Northern Lights (977); Desert Spice (944); Alpine Dusk (982); Alpine Dawn (980); Rising Wave (978). Full store price range 18.37-34.99. Kept exactly as the user listed it (Crag Reflective Dog Collar).

products.size: 3/4 in or 1 in wide, 11.5 in to 32 in

products.image_alt: GoTags personalized reflective dog collar with engraved aluminium nameplate
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Beige / Small 11-16"', USD 15.95, store SKU dog-refadj-beige-tag-aluminum-small. Store options: Blue; X-Small 8-12"; Small 11-16"; Medium 14-20"; Large 18-26"; Light Blue; Red; Pink. Full store price range 13.95-15.95. Kept as the user's GoTags Personalized Pet Collar.

products.name: Blue-9 Secure Pro Dog Collar
products.description: A quick release collar from Blue-9's Secure Pro line, stocked from Small to Large in several colours. It is the everyday collar of the Blue-9 range, sold separately from the Balance harness.
